scripts.build:studio: vite build --config vite.studio.config.js && node scripts/make-page.mjs studio-page.html dist-studio/studio.html
scripts.build:itch: VITE_TESTER=1 vite build --outDir dist-itch && node scripts/make-page.mjs itch-page.html dist-itch/index.html
scripts.build:house-demo: VITE_DEMO=house vite build --outDir dist-demo && node scripts/make-page.mjs house-demo-page.html dist-demo/index.html && sed -i 's#<title>Dungeon of Soldia</title>#<title>Monster House Demo</title>#' house-demo-page.html
scripts.build:brood-demo: VITE_DEMO=brood vite build --outDir dist-demo && node scripts/make-page.mjs brood-demo-page.html dist-demo/index.html && sed -i 's#<title>Dungeon of Soldia</title>#<title>Brood Mother Demo</title>#' brood-demo-page.html
